papers.title: Overnight drift in major currency pairs
papers.summary: EURUSD and USDJPY earn most of their daily return overnight. A long-overnight rule earns a Sharpe ratio of 0.8 after costs from 2012 to 2023, falling to 0.5 on the held-out years.
papers.testable_why: The rule needs only hourly FX quotes and fixed entry and exit times.
papers.replicable_why: It needs only EURUSD and USDJPY prices.

citations.claim: A long-overnight rule earns a Sharpe ratio of 0.8 after costs.
citations.quote: a long-overnight rule earns an annualised Sharpe ratio of 0.8 after a cost of 0.4 pips per side

papers.title: Regime filters cut drawdowns in trend following on index futures
papers.summary: A volatility regime filter on a 50-day trend rule cuts maximum drawdown from 31% to 18%, and keeps a Sharpe ratio of 0.7 out of sample.
papers.testable_why: Both the trend rule and the filter run on daily futures prices.
papers.replicable_why: Index CFD prices stand in for the futures.

citations.claim: The filter cuts maximum drawdown from 31% to 18%.
citations.quote: cuts maximum drawdown from 31% to 18% over 2000 to 2024

papers.title: Volatility breakouts in gold futures around US data releases
papers.summary: A breakout rule after US inflation releases reports a Sharpe ratio of 2.6 before costs, with no out-of-sample test.
papers.testable_why: A Sharpe ratio of 2.6 on daily data with no costs and no held-out test points to lookahead.
papers.replicable_why: It needs only gold prices and the release calendar.
flags: Sharpe above 2 on daily data: assume lookahead until shown otherwise

citations.claim: The breakout rule earns a Sharpe ratio of 2.6 before costs.
citations.quote: earns a Sharpe ratio of 2.6 on daily returns from 2015 to 2024, before costs
